description: The frozen bounded serious-application benchmark. One vertical slice, held still so that a rerun measures the factory rather than a moved target. Validated and executed by tooling/application-journey-benchmark.test.mjs against schemas/application-journey-benchmark.schema.json. The domain is football because the reference product is; the vocabulary below is declared precisely so it can be kept out of every factory surface.

benchmark.title: Scheduled entity, locked decision, official settlement, ranked score
benchmark.rationale: This is the shortest journey that still forces server-authoritative time, an external truth boundary, idempotent settlement and per-identity isolation to all be real at once.

scheduled.description: The entity exists with a future deadline. Decisions are open.

locked.description: The deadline has passed. Decisions are closed and existing ones become visible.

awaiting-official.description: The event has finished but no official result has been accepted yet.

settled.description: An official result was accepted and every decision has been scored.

voided.description: The event will not produce an official result. Decisions are discarded, not scored.

transitions.guard: server clock is at or past the stored deadline
the official source reports the event will not take place
the official source reports play has concluded
the official source reports the event was abandoned
the reported status is the official status, not a provisional one
the official source withdraws the event

lock.refusalReason: The decision window for this entity closed at its stored deadline.

officialResult.source: single configured official results feed, recorded with provenance and observation time
officialResult.correctionPolicy: A corrected official result re-runs settlement under the same identity key and replaces the score. The correction is recorded; the previous score is not silently overwritten without one.

scoring.rule: Exact outcome scores 3; correct direction with wrong margin scores 1; anything else scores 0.
scoring.singleSourceOfTruth: one database function, called by the settlement path and by nothing else

identities.label: A competitor with an early decision
A competing identity whose data must never be visible to A
